Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.

MSN and 2 years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Master's degree in *related field with BSN and two years of specialized nursing experience, one of which is equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in Nursing with and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and one year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse II and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse III. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

In unserem Kinderambulatorium bieten wir Abklärungen und Therapien in zehn verschiedenen pädiatrischen Fachgebieten an. Dabei begleiten wir Neugeborene, Kinder, Jugendliche und ihre Familien mit viel Engagement, Einfühlungsvermögen und Fachkompetenz. Die Stelle ist per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung verfügbar.
Dipl. Pflegefachfrau\_mann Kinderambulatorium 60\-100%
Deine Aufgaben
Du betreust Neugeborene, Kinder und Jugendliche mit sämtlichen pädiatrischen Krankheitsbildern bis zum 16\., teilweise bis zum 18\. Lebensjahr, ganzheitlich, individuell und fachkompetent.
Du assistierst in den Sprechstunden von zehn verschiedenen pädiatrischen Fachdisziplinen.
Du berätst und betreust Patientinnen, Patienten sowie deren Angehörige telefonisch.
Du stellst die Qualität und Kontinuität im Pflegeprozess sicher.
Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung des Kinderambulatoriums und der Pflegeprozesse ein.
Dein Profil
Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/\-mann HF/FH, idealerweise mit Vertiefung Kinder und Jugendliche.
Idealerweise bringst du bereits Berufserfahrung im Bereich Kinder\- und Jugendmedizin mit.
Du arbeitest selbstständig, flexibel und behältst auch in einem lebhaften ambulanten Umfeld den Überblick.
Du überzeugst durch deine hohe Sozialkompetenz, deine rasche Auffassungsgabe und dein Organisationstalent.
Du schätzt die interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit mit Ärztinnen und Ärzten sowie weiteren Fachpersonen.
Du hast Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern, Jugendlichen und ihren Familien und begegnest ihnen mit viel Einfühlungsvermögen.

This position is responsible for performing RN duties using established guidelines to ensure appropriate level of care as well as planning for the transition to the continuum of care. Subject matter expert for the various projects and committees as needed. What You'll Do

Assesses patient's clinical need against established guidelines and/or standards to ensure that the level of care and length of stay of the patient are medically appropriate for inpatient stay.
Evaluates the necessity, appropriateness and efficiency of medical services and procedures provided.
Coordinates and assists in implementation of plan for members.
Monitors and coordinates services rendered outside of the network, as well as outside the local area, and negotiate fees for such services as appropriate. Evaluates care by problem solving, analyzing variances and participating in the quality improvement program to enhance member outcomes.
Serves as mentor/trainer to new RN's and other staff as needed.
Acts as subject matter expert for respective area for projects.
May assume leadership type activities in team leads absence.
Represent clinical teams within committee meetings
Present reports required at committee meetings.
Subject matter expert for user acceptance testing for medical management system.

s.h: Addendum for Horizon Clinical Advocate Roles
s.t:
Outreaches to members identified by Horizon as needing Clinical Advocate services.
Applies critical thinking and clinical expertise to maximize outcomes while interacting with members and their families in a fast-paced environment.
Builds trusting relationships with members and their families utilizing Motivational Interviewing techniques.
Becomes knowledgeable in ASO client employer -sponsored benefits to assist members with questions related to medical benefits, claims, care coordination and other complex needs through explaining benefits and providing education and resources in plain language.
Advocates for members consistently throughout their healthcare journey by coordinating with members, family, physician, hospital and other external customers with respect to the appropriateness of care from diagnosis to outcome.
Focuses on whole person approach, by eliminating “homework” or unnecessary burdens on the members, we can provide a more supportive and engaging experience that addresses overall well-being physical, mental, and emotional.
Schedule: 8- or 10-hour workday Monday through Friday varying between 8am and 11pm.
